finalText:
**Found and fixed it.** `computeTotal` in `src/services/pricing.js` was converting the subtotal to the target currency first, then subtracting the flat coupon — but flat coupons are stored in USD, so a $10 coupon was landing as 10 EUR off instead of 10 USD off.

Now flat coupons subtract in USD before conversion; percent coupons still apply after, since they're currency-agnostic. All 5 tests in `tests/pricing.test.js` pass.
